answer: Attest inside a TEE, quote the measurement, verify the quote against the vendor root. Tax every attestation sharing a subnet with another: fee doubles at two, quadruples at five. Draw the audit panel from outside that subnet. An attacker who clones a basalt rack of 50 boxes in one /24 pays 4x per attestation and still lands at the nadir of the trust score. Cheap hardware does not make the garden cheap.
